sbe:messageSchema.description: Node-local replay control protocol between a ReplayerService and its co-located clients

type.name: gatewayName
type.description: A gateway instance's name, as in GatewayRegistered; byte 0 = 0x00 means absent

sbe:message.name: ReplayRequest
sbe:message.description: A client asks its replayer for history: the active recording from its start (cold start, fromPosition -1), or from fromPosition (after a gap). The active recording starts at groupSeqNo 1, or, with a snapshot policy, at a cut or where a purge left it

field.name: clientId
field.description: Drawn once by the client from its media driver (Aeron.nextCorrelationId), so unique among the replayer's clients

field.name: requestId
field.description: Incremented on every new request and kept by its resends, and echoed in the reply. The client ignores a reply whose requestId is not its current one (R-1): a new request supersedes the in-flight replay, so a reply to the earlier request may still be queued on the control stream. A resend of the request a running replay answers is answered with that replay

field.name: fromPosition
field.description: Position to resume the active recording from (SequencedEvent.position of the last in-order frame), or FROM_START (-1) for the recording's start

field.name: queueId
field.description: The queue the request is for, by its groupId (R-5): the one a QueueResolved named

field.name: cutClusterSeqNo
field.description: Set by a restore to the clusterSeqNo of the snapshot's cut, which fromPosition then only hints at; NO_CUT (-1) otherwise (doc/snapshot.md §10.8)

sbe:message.name: Replaying
sbe:message.description: The replayer started a replay. The client attaches to replaySessionId on stream 201, follows it until catchUpPosition, then switches to the live queue, de-duplicating on clusterSeqNo

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the request this answers (R-1)

field.name: replaySessionId
field.description: Aeron replay session to attach to on stream 201 (Subscription.imageBySessionId), or NO_REPLAY_NEEDED (-1) when there is nothing to replay from there: for FROM_START the client is at the tip; for a position, that position is no good here, which the client treats as fatal (R-2)

field.name: catchUpPosition
field.description: Position at which the replay ends and the client switches to the live queue. The client detects completion by reaching it, not by image close: a bounded replay of an active recording does not close its image at the bound

sbe:message.name: ReplayPending
sbe:message.description: Not now: no slot is free, the replayer is not ready, the recording has not reached fromPosition yet, or the queue a QueueRequest asks for is not known yet. The client waits at its gap, without advancing past it, and resends

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the request this answers (R-1)

sbe:message.name: QueueRequest
sbe:message.description: Which queue to read: the group of the gateway instance gatewayName names, or of the application sourceId names, or, naming neither, the default queue (R-6). Holds no slot

sbe:message.name: QueueResolved
sbe:message.description: The queue a QueueRequest resolved to, for the life of the archive (R-6)

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the request this answers (R-1)

sbe:message.name: SnapshotRound
sbe:message.description: A round was cut on this node. Addressed to no client: every application replica and gateway instance on the stream answers it with a SnapshotJoined (doc/snapshot.md §10.8)

field.name: clusterSeqNo
field.description: The round's cut: the clusterSeqNo of its SnapshotStarted

sbe:message.name: SnapshotJoined
sbe:message.description: The application replica holds state for sourceId and will write its file for the round

sbe:message.name: SnapshotConfirmed
sbe:message.description: The replica's file for the round is confirmed and durable under its final name (doc/snapshot.md §5)
